state-indicator-contrast-adjacent-surfac.mechanism: The ON-state indicator is the thumb's position, read from the thumb against the track it rides. On the ON switches the thumb is recoloured a pale 'frosted' green #74B97A sitting inside the green ON-track #4E9E52 at ~1.32:1, far below 3:1, and its drop-shadow is removed, so the only ON/OFF cue cannot be located. The green-track-vs-white-page (~3.31:1) is the wrong, exonerating comparison.
state-indicator-contrast-adjacent-surfac.scenario: SaaS analytics notification settings with custom toggle switches. Three are ON: the track turns green #4E9E52 (~3.31:1 vs the white page, distractor PASS), but on/off is conveyed by thumb POSITION, and the pale frosted thumb #74B97A rides directly on the green track #4E9E52 at ~1.32:1 — the state-conveying part fails the surface it travels along.
state-indicator-contrast-adjacent-surfac.note: Colours and ratios drifted: actual CSS uses ON-track #4E9E52 (prose said #2E7D32) and ON-thumb #74B97A (prose said #C8C8C8); the thumb sits on the green track, there is no separate #B0B0B0 'position rail'. Track-vs-page is ~3.31:1, not ~5.1:1. The thumb-on-track failure (~1.32:1) is genuinely present.

focus-indicator-geometry-inner-border-pa.mechanism: The 'Confirm appointment' button is a SOLID brand-blue primary button: interior fill #4189B9 with a 2px #4189B9 border tracing its visible edge. On focus it adds no outer outline — it recolours its own border in place from blue to green #4B933A, staying at the visible boundary. Because the recoloured border sits within the visible boundary it must contrast with the component it borders (the blue interior); green-on-blue is 1.005:1, so the focus indicator is imperceptible.
focus-indicator-geometry-inner-border-pa.scenario: Cedar Park Health appointment-confirm screen. The 'Confirm appointment' CTA is a solid brand-blue (#4189B9) primary button with a 2px blue border at its visible edge. On focus it recolours that border in place from blue to green #4B933A — a change within the visible boundary; green vs the blue interior is 1.005:1.
focus-indicator-geometry-inner-border-pa.note: Component type drifted: the button is a SOLID blue primary button (fill #4189B9, blue border same hue), not an 'outlined ghost button ... over a light blue-tinted interior'. The branding/topic also differs (Cedar Park Health, not Lumen Photo Cloud pricing). The in-place border-recolour failure (green #4B933A vs blue interior #4189B9 = 1.005:1) is exactly as described.

exemption-boundaries-inactive-hover-esse.mechanism: One role=toolbar holds four visually-similar controls needing different verdicts: a disabled Delete tool (~1.7:1 #b9b9b9 icon, NA/inactive); an active Draw tool (.tool--active-fail, same ~1.7:1 #b9b9b9 icon, FAILS as it must reach 3:1); an active Zoom tool (#3a3a3a icon ~7.6:1 plus a supplemental hover glow, NA); and a symbolic ✕ close glyph #9c9c9c at ~2.0:1 (FAILS as non-text content). Multiple active controls below 3:1 make the surface fail.
exemption-boundaries-inactive-hover-esse.scenario: RTL (Arabic) transit-authority route-map editor. One role=toolbar holds four visually-similar controls needing different verdicts: a disabled Delete tool (~1.7:1 icon, NA/inactive), an active Draw tool (same ~1.7:1 icon, FAILS), an active Zoom tool (#3a3a3a icon ~7.6:1 plus a supplemental hover glow, NA), and a symbolic ✕ close glyph (~2.0:1, FAILS as non-text content). RTL places the close glyph on the visual left.
exemption-boundaries-inactive-hover-esse.note: Two distractor-control ratios drifted from the page's own CSS: Zoom icon is #3a3a3a at ~7.6:1 (prose said 9.2:1) and the ✕ close glyph is #9c9c9c at ~2.0:1 (prose said ~2.75:1). Verdicts are unaffected and the primary failing control (.tool--active-fail Draw, ~1.7:1) is exact.
